"};
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),ctx=$('c').getContext('2d'),I={};const clamp=(x,a=0,b=1)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x)),ease=x=>{x=clamp(x);return x*x*(3-2*x)},mix=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;const durations={Idle:2400,'Dark Bolt':1700,'Dark Mend':1900,Hex:1800,Death:1690};const descriptions={Idle:'Breathing, anchored feet and crystal pulse.','Dark Bolt':'Staff charge → smoky purple bolt → impact smoke on Ironbound.','Dark Mend':'Staff lift → green helix surrounds the injured Raider.',Hex:'Staff lift → spectral skull rises above Ironbound.',Death:'Staff falls separately → body collapses → original goblin smoke and skull.'};let t=0,last=0,playing=true,ready=false;const val=id=>+$ (id).value;const S={x:385,y:285,h:144,w:144*610/644};const target={x:109,y:193},ally={x:252,y:286};function sprite(img,x,y,h,w=h*img.width/img.height){ctx.drawImage(img,x-w/2,y-h,w,h)}function shadow(x,y,w){ctx.drawImage(I.shadow,x-w/2,y-10,w,20)}function glow(x,y,r,col,a){if(a<=0)return;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=clamp(a);let g=ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,r);g.addColorStop(0,col);g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(x-r,y-r,r*2,r*2);ctx.restore()}function puff(x,y,r,a,col='rgba(54,12,80,.95)'){for(let i=0;i<9;i++){let angle=i*2.4;glow(x+Math.cos(angle)*r*.5,y+Math.sin(angle)*r*.35,r*(.6+i%3*.15),col,a*(.7+i%2*.2))}}function shamanPart(key,dx,dy,angle=0,alpha=1,pivotX=.5,pivotY=.9,sy=1){ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=clamp(alpha);let x=S.x-S.w/2+pivotX*S.w,y=S.y-S.h+pivotY*S.h;ctx.translate(x+dx,y+dy);ctx.rotate(angle);ctx.scale(1,sy);ctx.drawImage(I[key],-pivotX*S.w,-pivotY*S.h,S.w,S.h);ctx.restore()}function ring(x,y,rx,ry,color){ctx.save();ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=1.3;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,rx,ry,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()}
function deathSmoke(x,y,t){if(t<=0||t>=1)return;let grow=ease(t/.34),fade=1-ease((t-.60)/.40),scale=val('smoke')/100;ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.scale(scale,scale);let lift=22*ease(t);ctx.globalAlpha=fade*.8*grow;let sw=29+15*grow,sh=22+lift;ctx.drawImage(I.smoke,-sw/2,-sh,sw,sh);let w=28+88*grow,h=20+38*grow;ctx.globalAlpha=fade*grow;ctx.drawImage(I.smoke,-w/2,-h-lift,w,h);ctx.globalAlpha=fade*.66*grow;ctx.drawImage(I.smoke,-48*grow,-17,96*grow,23);ctx.restore()}
function skull(x,y,t,scale=1){if(t<=0||t>=1)return;ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y-43-66*ease(t));let s=scale*(.78+.22*ease(t));ctx.scale(s,s);ctx.globalAlpha=ease(t/.16)*(1-ease((t-.53)/.47));ctx.shadowBlur=5;ctx.shadowColor='#b6a5cf';ctx.drawImage(I.skull,-28,-26,56,56*I.skull.height/I.skull.width);ctx.restore()}

document.title='Goblin Shaman — Combined Lab v2';
for(const [id,label,min,max,value] of [['sway','Idle sway (degrees)',0,12,3],['swayRate','Idle sway speed (%)',25,200,100],['boltSize','Bolt size (%)',50,200,120],['mendWrap','Healing radius (%)',70,170,115],['hexSize','Hex face size (%)',50,200,110]]){
 const l=document.createElement('label');l.innerHTML=label+' <output id="'+id+'Out"></output><input id="'+id+'" type="range" min="'+min+'" max="'+max+'" value="'+value+'">';$('lift').closest('label').after(l);
}
descriptions.Idle='Feet planted, adjustable side-to-side sway.';
descriptions['Dark Mend']='Green energy coils behind and in front of the Raider, with healing motes and a restorative pulse.';
descriptions.Hex='A dark, distorted apparition with luminous violet eyes.';
function castBody(lift){
 const im=I.body, w=im.width,h=im.height, x=S.x-S.w/2,y=S.y-S.h;
 // Local deformation of the staff-side sleeve, with fixed shoulder and smooth falloff.
 const step=4;
 for(let ix=0;ix<w;ix+=step){
  const n=Math.min(step,w-ix),u=(ix+n/2)/w;
  const weight=clamp((.43-u)/.19)*clamp((u-.19)/.05);
  if(weight===0||lift===0){ctx.drawImage(im,ix,0,n,h,x+ix/w*S.w,y,n/w*S.w,S.h);continue}
  const top=Math.round(h*.40),mid=Math.round(h*.49),bottom=Math.round(h*.60),dy=lift*weight;
  const bounds=[0,top,mid,bottom,h],dest=[0,top/h*S.h,mid/h*S.h-dy,bottom/h*S.h,S.h];
  for(let j=0;j<4;j++)ctx.drawImage(im,ix,bounds[j],n,bounds[j+1]-bounds[j],x+ix/w*S.w,y+dest[j],n/w*S.w,dest[j+1]-dest[j]);
 }
}
function mendLayer(p,m,front){
 if(p<=.25||p>=.95)return;
 let q=(p-.25)/.70,a=Math.sin(Math.PI*q)*m,rx=37*val('mendWrap')/100;
 for(let j=0;j<2;j++){
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=clamp(a*(front?1:.7));ctx.strokeStyle=j?'#d8ff9c':'#36ed78';ctx.lineWidth=j?1.2:4;ctx.shadowColor='#51ff89';ctx.shadowBlur=front?7:4;ctx.beginPath();let active=false;
  for(let i=0;i<=180;i++){let u=i/180,ang=u*Math.PI*5-q*11+j*.13,z=Math.sin(ang),xx=ally.x+Math.cos(ang)*rx*(1-.22*u),yy=ally.y-8-u*106+z*9;
   if((z>=0)===front){if(active)ctx.lineTo(xx,yy);else ctx.moveTo(xx,yy);active=true}else active=false;
  }ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
 }
 if(front){glow(ally.x,ally.y-55,49,'rgba(85,255,119,.40)',a);for(let i=0;i<22;i++){let f=(q*1.7+i*.173)%1,ang=i*2.4+q*5;let x=ally.x+Math.cos(ang)*rx*(.5+.5*Math.sin(i*8)**2),y=ally.y-8-f*118;glow(x,y,2.5+(i%3),i%3?'#82ff91':'#efffc4',a*Math.sin(Math.PI*f));}let pulse=ease(q/.25);ring(ally.x,ally.y-4,rx*pulse,9*pulse,'rgba(107,255,145,'+clamp(a*.8)+')');}
}
function hexFace(x,y,q,m){
 let a=Math.sin(Math.PI*q)*m,sc=val('hexSize')/100*(.7+.3*ease(q/.3));ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y-52-20*ease(q));ctx.scale(sc,sc);ctx.globalAlpha=clamp(a);
 for(let i=0;i<15;i++){let ang=i*2.4;glow(Math.cos(ang)*22,Math.sin(ang)*29,16,'rgba(48,8,73,.85)',.8);}
 ctx.shadowBlur=12;ctx.shadowColor='#7622b2';let g=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,-37,0,38);g.addColorStop(0,'#402052');g.addColorStop(.55,'#100b1c');g.addColorStop(1,'#291038');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-28,-20);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-35,-34,-32,-42);ctx.lineTo(-13,-29);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0,-38,13,-29);ctx.lineTo(32,-42);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(35,-34,28,-20);ctx.bezierCurveTo(40,0,19,23,0,39);ctx.bezierCurveTo(-19,23,-40,0,-28,-20);ctx.fill();
 ctx.fillStyle='#d38aff';ctx.shadowColor='#d38aff';for(let side of [-1,1]){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(side*5,-7);ctx.lineTo(side*24,-17);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(side*23,-1,side*5,-7);ctx.fill();}ctx.fillStyle='#090510';ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-10,10);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0,3,10,10);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(4,31,0,29);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-4,31,-10,10);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();
}
function bolt(x,y,dx,dy,p,m){let k=val('boltSize')/100, len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;dx/=len;dy/=len;for(let i=14;i>=0;i--){let d=i*3.4*k,off=Math.sin(i*1.7+p*48)*5*k;let xx=x-d*dx-dy*off,yy=y-d*dy+dx*off;puff(xx,yy,(4+i*.55)*k,(1-i/16)*.65*m,'rgba(62,13,95,.95)');}glow(x,y,13*k,'rgba(131,28,218,.95)',m);glow(x,y,5*k,'#d49aff',m);for(let i=0;i<7;i++){let ang=i*2.4+p*25;glow(x+Math.cos(ang)*9*k,y+Math.sin(ang)*6*k,2*k,'#b66aff',m*.75);}}
function render(){if(!ready)return;let mode=$('mode').value,ms=t*durations[mode],p=t,m=val('magic')/100;ctx.setTransform(2,0,0,2,0,0);ctx.clearRect(0,0,460,294);ctx.drawImage(I.bg,0,0,460,294);shadow(109,280,126);sprite(I.iron,109,280,182,130);shadow(ally.x,ally.y,88);if(mode==='Dark Mend')mendLayer(p,m,false);sprite(I.ally,ally.x,ally.y,117);let dead=mode==='Death';shadow(S.x,S.y,89*(dead?1-.6*ease((ms-650)/700):1));if(!dead){let charge=mode==='Idle'?0:ease(p/.24)*(1-ease((p-.65)/.35));let lift=val('lift')*charge;let tilt=-.045*charge;let sway=mode==='Idle'?Math.sin(p*Math.PI*2)*val('sway')*Math.PI/180:0;ctx.save();ctx.translate(S.x,S.y);ctx.rotate(sway);ctx.translate(-S.x,-S.y);castBody(lift);shamanPart('staff',0,-lift,tilt,1,.22,.53);let px=S.x-S.w/2+.22*S.w,py=S.y-S.h+.53*S.h,dx=(.17-.22)*S.w,dy=(.145-.53)*S.h;let crystal={x:px+dx*Math.cos(tilt)-dy*Math.sin(tilt),y:py-lift+dx*Math.sin(tilt)+dy*Math.cos(tilt)};glow(crystal.x,crystal.y,13+10*charge,'rgba(190,57,255,.8)',(.35+.18*Math.sin(p*Math.PI*4)+.45*charge)*m);for(let i=0;i<7;i++){let f=(p*1.5+i/7)%1;glow(crystal.x+Math.sin(f*7+i)*8,crystal.y-f*24,2,'#d59bff',(1-f)*.6*m)}ctx.restore();if(mode==='Dark Bolt'){let f=clamp((p-.30)/.30);if(p>=.30&&p<.60){let x=mix(crystal.x,target.x,f),y=mix(crystal.y,target.y,f);bolt(x,y,target.x-crystal.x,target.y-crystal.y,p,m)}if(p>=.60){let q=clamp((p-.60)/.30);puff(target.x,target.y,9+24*ease(q),(1-q)*m);}}if(mode==='Dark Mend')mendLayer(p,m,true);if(mode==='Hex'&&p>.28&&p<.94){let q=(p-.28)/.66;glow(target.x,target.y-69,32,'rgba(102,22,150,.7)',Math.sin(q*Math.PI)*m);hexFace(target.x,target.y+5,q,m);}}else{let q=ease((ms-120)/530),split=ease((ms-300)/350),fx=clamp((ms-770)/700),alpha=1-ease(fx/.32);let theta=-1.30*q;for(let [k,dx,dy,rot] of [['bodyrest',0,0,0],['rightleg',15,0,.3],['leftleg',-9,2,-.2],['torso',0,-3,0],['arm',-17,2,-.3],['head',-24,-5,-.25]])shamanPart(k,-12*q+dx*split,5*q+dy*split,theta+rot*split,alpha,.55,.9);shamanPart('staff',-26*q,5*q,-1.48*q,1-ease(fx/.55),.22,.92);deathSmoke(S.x-22,S.y-13.5,fx);skull(S.x-22,S.y-13.5,clamp((fx-.22)/.78),val('skull')/100);}ctx.drawImage(I.fg,0,0,460,294);ctx.drawImage(I.fade,0,256,460,38);if(!dead||ms===0)ring(S.x,S.y-6,30,7,'#e3c577');$('time').value=Math.round(t*1000);$('timeOut').textContent=Math.round(ms)+' ms';$('status').textContent=playing?'Playing':t>=1?'Finished':'Paused';}
function tick(now){if(playing&&last){t+=Math.min(80,now-last)*val('speed')/100*($('mode').value==='Idle'?val('swayRate')/100:1)/durations[$('mode').value];if(t>=1){if($('loop').checked)t%=1;else{t=1;playing=false;$('play').textContent='Play'}}}last=now;render();requestAnimationFrame(tick)}function reset(){t=0;render()}$('mode').onchange=()=>{t=0;playing=true;$('play').textContent='Pause';$('desc').textContent=descriptions[$('mode').value];};$('play').onclick=()=>{if(t>=1)t=0;playing=!playing;$('play').textContent=playing?'Pause':'Play';};$('reset').onclick=()=>{playing=false;$('play').textContent='Play';reset()};$('time').oninput=()=>{playing=false;$('play').textContent='Play';t=val('time')/1000;render()};for(let id of ['speed','lift','magic','smoke','skull','sway','swayRate','boltSize','mendWrap','hexSize']){let fn=()=>{$(id+'Out').textContent=val(id)+(id==='lift'?' px':id==='sway'?'°':'%');render()};$(id).oninput=fn;fn()}Promise.all(Object.entries(sources).map(([k,v])=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{let img=new Image;img.onload=()=>{I[k]=img;resolve()};img.onerror=reject;img.src=v}))).then(()=>{ready=true;$('mode').onchange();requestAnimationFrame(tick)}).catch(e=>$('status').textContent='Asset load failed');</script></body></html>
